threat_event: Customer device content or data is viewed, copied, or exposed at repair benches anywhere in the group
threat_source: Malicious or curious technician; attacker on a bench workstation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No technical limit or session record of technician access at stores and in-store counters; shared bench logins at 260 counters; data transfer caches never wiped
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D2 bench workstations; customer devices in custody (Device Repair and IT Support)
regulatory_driver: N81-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(n)); N81-R02 (Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)); Manufacturer A agreement (contract)
existing_controls: Background checks; signed access standard at most stores; CCTV; depot session logging
treatment_plan: Named bench accounts; session logging and USB block at all benches; cache wipe at session end; access standard signed by all technicians

threat_event: An attacker or malware moves from in-store repair counter benches into the retail cardholder data environment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bench network reachable from POS lanes at 112 stores; bench tools run as administrator; customer devices under repair connect to benches
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D4 store networks; SYS-D3 POS lanes; SYS-D2 counter benches
existing_controls: Store firewalls; EDR on benches and lanes; annual retail segmentation test
treatment_plan: Separate counter bench networks with no route to the CDE at the 112 stores; segmentation test before ROC fieldwork closes; repeat every 6 months
owner: Electronics Retail CISO with the Device Repair CISO

threat_event: A compromised RMM or remote support account pushes malicious scripts to managed customer endpoints
threat_source: Cybercriminal group targeting managed service providers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 standing RMM global administrators; RMM console MFA not phishing-resistant; scripts to many customers need no second approver
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D5 RMM and remote support tool; 310,000 customer endpoints
regulatory_driver: N54-R06 (45 CFR 164.308(a)(4)); N54-R06 (45 CFR 164.410); IT Support managed services contracts; N52-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05)
existing_controls: SSO from SYS-G1; SIEM monitoring of RMM logs; SOC 2 controls
treatment_plan: Two break-glass global administrators plus just-in-time elevation; phishing-resistant MFA; two-person approval for multi-customer scripts; RMM anomaly rules
owner: IT Support security and compliance lead

threat_event: A compromised update of a third-party tool runs on group endpoints with administrator rights
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 40 bench tools self-update from vendor sites with no integrity check; remote support and RMM agents trusted on customer endpoints
existing_controls: EDR; gold images rebuilt monthly
treatment_plan: Tool review gate; updates only through the group software channel with signature checks; allow-listing; vendor assessments for the top 10 tools

threat_event: Passcodes and account credentials kept in group systems are exposed in bulk
threat_source: Attacker with a workforce account; insider export
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 2.1 million tickets with passcodes and 96,000 with account passwords in STPP notes; chatbot transcripts and PSA attachments also hold credentials
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D1 STPP; SYS-G4 chatbot; SYS-D5 PSA and credential vault
existing_controls: Passcode vault at 680 stores; MFA; SIEM export alerts
treatment_plan: Vault at all stores; purge notes; stop collecting account passwords; redact chatbot transcripts; scan and purge PSA attachments

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses one or more acquirer, manufacturer, TPA, customer, regulator, or investor notice deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Matrix lists duties but lacks manufacturer, TPA, and enterprise contract clocks with owners; never exercised
existing_controls: Group IR plan; disclosure committee
treatment_plan: Complete the matrix (P08); cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared services and halts stores, depots, and managed services
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity, network, and SaaS tools connect all divisions; unsupported bench operating systems
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; PAM; immutable backups in provider B
treatment_plan: Retire unsupported bench systems; quarterly restore tests; cross-division tabletop (P08)

threat_event: Workforce credentials are phished or session tokens stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 45,000 users; number-matching MFA is not phishing-resistant outside administrators
existing_controls: MFA for all; quarterly phishing exercises; risk-based sign-in
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant authenticators for remote and high-risk roles by 2027-06-30; token binding where supported

threat_event: A device leaves the trade-in or recycling chain with recoverable customer data
threat_source: Process failure; resale buyer or recycler recovers data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2019 standard on SP 800-88 Rev. 1; no per-device record for recycling drop-offs; no verification sampling at 2 depots
existing_controls: Per-device certificates for trade-ins; certified recycler
treatment_plan: Standard on SP 800-88 Rev. 2 with verification (4.5.1) and Appendix C certificates for every device

threat_event: AI used with customers or customer systems without adequate governance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI diagnostics without accuracy measurement; chatbot shared across divisions; AI agent runs scripts on customer endpoints; Group AI Standard adopted after deployment
existing_controls: Group AI Standard and council (2026)
treatment_plan: Group AI governance program conditions (P10)

threat_event: Control gaps at depots and data recovery labs go unnoticed because inheritance is not documented
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inheritance never documented for depots and labs (scenario gap 9)
existing_controls: STPP inheritance documented in P02
treatment_plan: Inheritance matrix for depots and labs before repair QSA fieldwork

threat_event: Division staff follow outdated or conflicting standards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Device Repair supplement v2024; in-store counters follow retail store procedures
existing_controls: Group policies v2026
treatment_plan: Re-issue the Device Repair supplement with an in-store counter annex

threat_event: A critical third party fails and stops a division's core service
threat_source: Outage or breach at the TPA, RMM vendor, or processor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One TPA interface carries 38% of repair volume; one RMM vendor for all managed customers
regulatory_driver: N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req. 12.8); TPA agreement (contract)
existing_controls: Vendor reviews each year; processor P2PE listing
treatment_plan: Exit and fallback plans for the TPA and RMM; continuous monitoring of tier 1 vendors

threat_event: The materiality decision for a cyber incident is delayed or inconsistent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disclosure committee charter covers cyber, but no cross-division incident has tested it
existing_controls: Charter; escalation within 24 hours (POL-03 4.6)
treatment_plan: Materiality step in the cross-division tabletop

threat_event: Customer accounts on the shared customer platform are taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One customer account across divisions; MFA optional for consumers
existing_controls: Bot protection; breached password screening
treatment_plan: Passkeys offered; step-up verification for repair release changes and stored payment tokens

threat_event: Payment page scripts are tampered with on either merchant's payment pages
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Script inventory and change detection exist on both pages; alerts reviewed weekly
existing_controls: Script inventories; processor hosted payment fields
treatment_plan: Real-time alerts to the SOC; payment-pages-only tag container

threat_event: Insiders commit fraud through refunds, parts, or gift cards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dual control exists but exception reports are reviewed monthly
existing_controls: Dual approval for refunds and write-offs
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; monthly exception review continues

threat_event: Customer devices in custody are lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Locked cages and CCTV; courier handoffs for mail-in and depot work
existing_controls: Cages; CCTV; tamper-evident shipping
treatment_plan: Cycle counts of devices in custody weekly; courier chain-of-custody scans

threat_event: Attacks on division estates go undetected because telemetry is incomplete
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bench workstation logs beyond EDR not collected; IT Support PSA logs kept 90 days
existing_controls: EDR; SIEM for cloud and identity
treatment_plan: Onboard bench telemetry and PSA logs to the SIEM

threat_event: New or changed rules are missed (state privacy laws, the next PCI DSS version, CIRCIA)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tracking sits with counsel in each division
existing_controls: Annual counsel review
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; group regulatory watch list reviewed each quarter
